title: Crew wallet, local SIM and receipts notes
content:
Quick scratch for the crew wallet / SIM / receipts flow — not polished, use as field reference.

OBJECTIVE:
- Make sure local reimbursements are fast and auditable. Minimize cash holding by crew. Leave clear handoff notes for finance.

PRE-EVENT CHECKLIST (two days before):
- Top-up crew wallet to target: USD 700 (split: petty cash USD 300, card float USD 400).
- Confirm spare local SIMs: 3 data-only + 2 voice+data. Label with phone numbers and assigned person.
- Export event expense codes from Confluence: EVENTS-2438 -> expense code 2026-RS-06.
- Print 10x blank receipt envelopes and sticky labels with "Event, Person, Date, USD/Currency, Purpose".

CURRENCY & RATES (reference):
- Host city local currency: MXN (example). Current quick rates: 1 USD = 18.9 MXN (check XE on arrival).
- Use USD for corporate cards, convert cash receipts to USD using card statement or XE midday rate. Document conversion.

VENDOR CONTACTS (local / on-site) — save to phone + paste in Slack #events-ops: 
- A/V: SonidoMx — Claudia Reyes — +52 55 3311 4422 — contact for last-minute mic swaps and power strips. Onsite lead: Marco A.
- Freight/Load-in: RapidLift Logistics — Hugo Torres — +52 1 55 9122 0077 — off-hours pickup ok, invoice required within 48h.
- Catering: ComidaExpress — Laura Mendez — +52 55 7700 6644 — send final headcount 24h prior. Cash deposit allowed 20% on arrival.
- SIM seller (airport kiosk): TelLocal Booth — Terminal 1, Stand B12 — ask for 10GB/30-day plan, charge MXN 350.
- Last-mile drivers: FleetGo — Dispatch +52 55 8888 0099 — prepay via card or cash to driver; get driver name & plate on receipt.

RECEIPTS PROCESS (field -> finance):
1) Collect every receipt. If vendor gives paper receipt, staple to printed envelope with sticky label: name, date, event code, who paid.
2) Photograph receipts immediately (phone camera), upload to Slack thread #events-receipts with caption: "NAME | AMOUNT | VENDOR | LOCAL CC/CASH". Use thread for that day's receipts only.
3) For cash items under USD 20, annotate who held petty cash and attach a short note (who signed out wallet).
4) For vendor invoices, request digital invoice (CFDI where relevant). If not available, capture full invoice image and vendor contact.
5) At end of day, team lead (Jordan) compiles receipts and drops into shared folder: /events/roadshows/2026/jun-city/receipts. Finance will process within 5 business days.

CREDIT CARD VS CASH GUIDELINES:
- Use corporate card for anything > USD 50 and vendor invoices.
- Use petty cash for tips, small taxi rides, kiosk purchases where card not accepted.
- No personal cards should be used unless emergency; if used, attach personal card statement snippet.

SIM MANAGEMENT (assign + data):
- Label SIMs: S1 (backup data), S2 (crew lead), S3 (vendor contact line), S4/5 spare.
- Record ICCID and phone number in the shared spreadsheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/roadshow-sims (update on issuance).
- Top-up plan: prefer single 30-day 10GB plan per SIM to avoid frequent top-ups. Keep receipts for data purchase.

CASH HANDOFF PROTOCOL:
- Two-person sign-out for petty cash: person A (holder) + manager signature (person B). Log amount, date, reason.
- If returning cash, count in front of manager and sign return log. Cash variance over $10 requires short note explaining discrepancy.

EMERGENCY NOTES / EDGE CASES:
- If vendor refuses to provide any receipt, do this: get a text confirmation from vendor (name, plate/ID), take photo of vendor ID/storefront, note exact time and amount, escalate to Marco for approval.
- Lost receipt: recreate with vendor confirmation email + photo of product/service + manager note. Finance may still reject — always aim to collect original.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODOs:
- Confirm whether finance will accept local-language receipts without translation (ask Aisha).
- Can we pre-authorize RapidLift invoice to central PO? Action: Jordan to open EVENTS-2438 ticket.
- Do we need to collect VAT invoices (CFDI) for catering? If yes, ask local vendor to provide RFC.

FIELD CHECKOUT (end of event):
- Reconcile petty cash against receipts before departure.
- Hand leftover SIMs to operations desk and mark "returned" in sheet.
- Upload all photos of receipts, envelope scans, and a single combined CSV of amounts to Slack #events-receipts and tag finance.

QUICK TEMPLATES (copy-paste for receipts Slack thread):
- "RECEIPT | NAME: <full name> | AMT: <USD/Local> | VENDOR: <name> | PAY: CASH/CARD | CODE: 2026-RS-06"
- "SIM ISSUE | S# | ICCID: <last4> | NUM: +52xxxx | ASSIGNED: <name>"

Notes-to-self: keep spare USD 100 for odd vendors (safe deposit in hotel safe), avoid large cash withdrawals at night, remind crew to photograph every card transaction (screenshots of card charges help speed reconciliation).

If anything ambiguous, ping me (Nina) or Jordan in Slack. We'll iterate after this run and turn into a one-pager.
